hero.subtitle: Legal
hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Silver14 Nail is committed to protecting your privacy and safeguarding your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit and shop on our website.

sections.title: INFORMATION WE COLLECT
sections.intro: When you place an order or create an account on our website, we collect the necessary personal information, including:

groups.label: Transaction Information
items: Details of the Nailbox products you purchase

groups.label: Technical Information
items: Data collected through cookies to improve your shopping experience on our website

notice.label: Important Notice
notice.text: We DO NOT store your credit card information or bank account details. All payments are securely processed through independent international payment providers such as PayPal, Stripe, or OnePAY.

sections.title: HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
sections.intro: We use your information solely for legitimate business purposes, including:
items: Confirming orders and creating handmade Nailbox products according to your requested measurements.
Arranging international shipping and providing order tracking information.
Sending order status updates and providing customer support services.
Preventing payment fraud and unauthorized access to our website systems.

sections.title: SHARING INFORMATION WITH THIRD PARTIES
paragraphs: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties for marketing or commercial purposes.
Your information may only be shared with trusted partners directly involved in fulfilling your order, including:

partners.label: Shipping Providers
partners.text: International courier services such as DHL, FedEx, UPS, EMS, and other shipping partners for delivering your orders.

partners.label: Payment Providers
partners.text: Authorized financial institutions and payment processors that securely handle payment transactions.

sections.title: DATA SECURITY
paragraphs: We implement strict security measures, including SSL encryption technology, to protect your personal information from loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely secure. Therefore, while we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security under all circumstances.

sections.title: CUSTOMER RIGHTS
paragraphs: You have the right to access, update, correct, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time by logging into your account or contacting us directly using the information provided below.
